create_GossipBuffer: create a GossipBuffer instance with topology, model, buffer_locks, read_events, write_events, and sync_list for multi-agent communication
write_message_GossipBuffer: write a model to the GossipBuffer broadcast buffer for a given agent rank with optional peer rotation
aggregate_message_GossipBuffer: aggregate in-neighbour messages from the GossipBuffer into the local model by averaging parameters
review_GossipBuffer_init: review the GossipBuffer constructor to understand how shared-memory message buffers and synchronization events are initialized
refactor_GossipBuffer_write_message: refactor the write_message method to support rotating peers with sync_freq greater than one
